name: Skeletal Sacristan

facts.text: Level 77, 100,000 health. He walks a fixed round of the high walk; Offline DAoC makes him stand while he is fought, because a raid could not keep up with his round.
A sacristan keeps a church's sacred vessels and vestments.

story:
Arawn's gaol had a chapel of its own, and the chapel had a sacristan to keep its vessels: the cups, the lamps, and, the Inconnu say, the rim of a cauldron that nine maidens once kept warm with their breath. The vessels are long gone, stolen or broken when the gaol rose, but the Sacristan does not know it. He walks his round of the high walk as he always has, from the sacristy to the chapel and back, checking for things that are no longer there. He will not stop for you. You must stop him.

The keeper of the vessels. Arawn's gaol had a chapel, and the chapel had a sacristan to keep its vessels: the cups and lamps, the vestments, and, the Inconnu say, the rim of the cauldron that nine maidens once kept warm with their breath, which Arawn lent to Caer Sidi so that its prisoners might be fed. The vessels are long gone, stolen or broken when the gaol rose, and the cauldron's rim lies cold in the larders below.

His round. The Sacristan does not know any of this, or does not accept it. He walks his round of the high walk as he always has, from the sacristy to the chapel and back, checking for things that are no longer there, and he used to walk it faster than a raid could run, so that whole raids chased him round the circuit for an hour and never caught him. On this server he stands to fight once a raid engages him. He will not stop for you of his own accord. You must stand in his way.
legend: He walks a fixed loop of the high walk and once outran whole raids. Here he stands and fights once engaged, so catch him on his walk, hold him there and burn him; do not chase him round the circuit, let him come to you and block. He resets a minute after the fight leaves him, so commit when you pull. Set the wall of tanks on the narrow stretch of the walk past the chapel door; he cannot get round you there. The old raids that ran after him for an hour still talk about it, and none of them fondly.

loremasterTopic.text: The keeper of the sacred vessels. He still walks his round on the high walk, though the vessels are long gone. Stand in his way.

bookPage: On the high walk we heard footsteps going round and round, always the same pace, always the same round, and Ennyn, our guide, said that the companies before ours had chased the Sacristan for an hour and never caught him. So we did not chase him. We stood across the walk in a wall and waited, and he came round to us, still looking for the vessels that are not there, and found us in his way instead. He seemed more puzzled than angry. When he fell he asked who would keep the vessels now. Nobody had an answer that would have comforted him.
